records.des: Clip-on glasses that make you mysterious.

records.name: Nailed Down

records.name: Flash of Gold Hat
records.des: Hat adorned with cute golden stars twinkling as you move.

records.name: 男列车长发型
records.des: 帅气随性的日常发型，有点儿像是没睡醒。

records.name: 女列车长发型
records.des: 可爱干练的日常发型，打理起来很省时间。

records.name: Lively Bunny Outfit
records.des: A set of bunny decorations that is not overly cute. The adorable decorations complement the handsome cut.

records.name: Bunny Ears Headband
records.des: Headband tied into the shape of bunny ears that requires practices to tie it in a casual and beautiful style.

records.name: Lively Bunny Shoes
records.des: The soles are very soft, ideal for running and jumping. The selling point is "letting you jump as high as a bunny."

records.name: Pilot Jacket
records.des: Jacket with a very warm fur collar issued to pilots in the past.

records.name: Pilot Ankle Boots
records.des: Boots previously issued to pilots, adopt a fully foot-conforming insulation design.

records.name: Pilot Sunglasses
records.des: Sunglasses previously issued to pilots, effective in blocking high-altitude ultraviolet rays.

records.name: Interleaved Hairpin
records.des: Simple and timeless classic hairpin.

records.name: Casual Set
records.des: Simple and timeless fashion coordination.

records.name: Dinosaur Skull
records.des: Supposed to be the trendy "old fashion", but isn't it a bit too old?

records.name: Dinosaur Research Coat
records.des: Jacket to go with a black-and-white skull motif, and in the same color palette as the skull.

records.name: Dinosaur Research Shoes
records.des: Shoes to go with a black-and-white skull motif that also go well with stacked socks.

records.name: Panda Ears
records.des: Poor replica of panda ears that seem to be souvenirs from a Night Chains Land store.

records.name: Clip
records.des: An ordinary clip... until it appears on Conductor's ear.

records.name: Future Dream Set
records.des: Jacket with striking colors that make it a perfect shopping outfit bound to make heads turn.

records.name: Future Dream Shoes
records.des: A pair of fashionable shoes in the latest design and striking colors that makes people ask "How did you snag them so soon" when walking down the street.

records.name: Seal Headpiece
records.des: Headwear sealed with the power of Black Iron. Don't ask why it's shaped like a bandage.

records.name: Demon Lord Eye Patch
records.des: Rupture, reality! Shatter, spirit! Ah... my eyes...

records.name: Fountain Set
records.des: Robe that amplifies the Demon Lord's power...

records.name: Boots of Revitalization
records.des: Sacrifice that revives the souls of eternal night!

records.name: Yellow Plastic Raincoat
records.des: The classic pale yellow plastic raincoat that is rather thick and of good quality.

records.name: Little Raindrop
records.des: Little Raindrop that follows you around but won't wet your hair.

records.name: Yellow Rainboots
records.des: Classic rain boots that allow you to step into puddles as you please!

records.name: Lightweight Hiking Set
records.des: A lightweight and breathable hiking set, coming with a practical fanny pack.

records.name: Lightweight Hiking Shoes
records.des: Lightweight and breathable hiking shoes, suitable for climbing and stream trekking.

records.name: Snowland Messenger Ornament
records.des: The feather jewelry worn by the snowland messenger in the story, harbingering good news.

records.name: Snowland Messenger Coat
records.des: The coat worn by the snowland messenger in the story, providing protection from harsh weather and ensuring punctuality for appointments.

records.name: Snowland Messenger Boots
records.des: The boots worn by the snowland messenger in the story, leaving footprints visible only to children on the snowy ground.

records.name: Windfall Talisman
records.des: When attached to forehead, this magical charm will attract a random amount of unexpected fortune.

records.name: Eyeball Headwear
records.des: An eye-catching eyeball headwear, it can freak people out.

records.name: Wasteland Hunter Headwear
records.des: A replica of the headwear worn by wasteland hunters, manufactured on an industrial assembly line with fake feathers.

records.name: Demihuman Ear
records.des: Ears inspired by the ears of demihumans, giving the wearer a furry appearance.

records.name: Electronic Demihuman Ear
records.des: Ears modeled after the mechanical ears of a female character in a specific video game, ideal for cosplay.

records.name: Gold Rush Hat
records.des: A costume once favored by gold diggers in past decades, still visible in archived newspaper photos.

records.name: Spike of Exorcism
records.des: This particular paper is believed to possess the power of exorcising evil spirits. Additional nails attached to the talisman look menacing.

records.name: Loading Hairpin
records.des: A hairpin that conveys doubt and contemplation. When worn, it creates the impression that your thoughts are radiating outward...

records.name: Speechless Hairpin
records.des: A hairpin that represents refraining from commenting. When worn, it signifies a desire to remain silent.

records.name: Brain Stop Eye Patch
records.des: This eye patch gives the impression of lacking intelligence for the wearer. If you wish to maintain a credible image, please do not wear it in front of others.

records.name: Azure Eye
records.des: An eye patch imbued with fantastical power! Unleash a combo attack now!

records.name: Malestrom Goggles
records.des: Sunglasses modeled after the preferred style of a certain gang leader in Shoggolith City, tempting you to engage in some rap.

records.name: Bunny Single Eye Patch
records.des: An eyepatch that features contrasting patterns and styles. Perhaps an attempt to achieve cuteness while maintaining a chuni vibe?

records.name: Singer's Flower
records.des: A costume inspired by the protagonist of a classic video game, modified so that it's not attached to the eye as per the original design. Such is the Flower of Tears that endures even if the world is destroyed several times.

records.name: Ghost Ear Clip
records.des: A delicate and miniature ghost-shaped ear clip, ideal for everyday wear compared to other horror-themed accessories.

records.name: Scar Patch
records.des: A sticker featuring a grim scar tattoo. Although advertised as perfectly realistic, its actual effect is still a subject of controversy.

records.name: Maid Outfit
records.des: This skirt serves as the centerpiece of the maid set, designed with modifications to the back strap and bowtie for convenient and quick changes.

records.name: Maid Headwear
records.des: A headwear accessory from the maid set, meticulously pleated beforehand to ensure flawlessness, as expected of a true maid.

records.name: Maid Boots
records.des: The soft leather boots belonging to the maid set, durable and lightweight, allowing the wearer to serve tea without tiring even after multiple occasions.

records.name: Star Earrings
records.des: These earrings radiate confidence, instantly transforming you into an eternal superstar on stage.

records.name: Soft Dreamland
records.des: A soft and beautiful hair tie that keeps your hair from obstructing your mouth while sleeping.

records.name: Classical Lolita Headwear
records.des: A classical Lolita-style headwear, featuring a simple yet elegant color scheme.

records.name: Trendy Set
records.des: A suit that sets the fashion trend. However, some people don't think it quite fits their understanding of trendy...

records.name: Comfortable Sleep
records.des: A short, loose-fitting nightgown paired with a color-coordinated jacket, perfect for loungewear.

records.name: Classical Lolita Dress
records.des: A classical Lolita-style dress, having remained popular for many years, beloved by purists.

records.name: Trendy Sandals
records.des: Sandals that set the fashion trend, with a minimalist style and an astounding price that may prompt people to exclaim, "Why so darn expensive?!"

records.name: Fluffy Steps
records.des: Indoor shoes that provide a sensation akin to walking on clouds, providing a comfortable and noiseless experience.

records.name: Classical Lolita Shoes
records.des: Well-crafted leather shoes, suitable for pairing with the classical Lolita-style dress.

records.name: Aerospace Dynamic Goggles
records.des: Goggles developed by Anita Aerospace Dynamics Lab. While they do not actually work in space, they serve as stylish (and functionally redundant) lab goggles.

records.name: Aerospace Dynamic Jumpsuit
records.des: A jumpsuit developed by Anita Aerospace Dynamics Lab, equipped with a jet system for easy movement in weightless environments. Not intended for use in regular environments.

records.name: Aerospace Dynamic Shoes
records.des: Aerospace shoes developed by Anita Aerospace Dynamics Lab, which are more effective when used in conjunction with the jumpsuit. Vostok has provided detailed information on its unique features.

records.name: Playful Hairstyle
records.des: A small change in hairstyle can make a difference in one's overall aura!

records.name: Ruckus Set
records.des: Its flamboyant flame patterns invite everyone around the wearer to join in the excitement.

records.name: Ruckus Boots
records.des: Some believe that these vibrant, flame-embellished boots are named for the loud clashing sound they make when the wearer walks.

records.name: Moonlight Butterfly
records.des: A headdress designed based on the legendary butterfly that flies across the Milky Way. The full moon gleams atop the mountain.

records.name: Dormant Wings
records.des: An ear clip designed based on the concept of the legendary butterfly shrouded by the night sky. It is said to have remained dormant among the mountains.

records.name: Pilot Suit
records.des: A costume inspired by the legend of a young man who understood the moonlight butterfly. "The winds of the era's end start to stir."

records.name: Cocoon of Night
records.des: Footwear designed based on the idea of the legendary cocoon that ended the war. The butterfly that flies across the Milky Way finally finds rest in a place free from strife, shining brightly.

records.idCN: 眼饰/dress39__虚拟环境生成装置
records.name: VR Device
records.des: The main device used to generate VR battle simulations. Its external lights are purely for decoration and do not represent the actual loading progress.

records.name: VR Monitoring Suit
records.des: A suit used to monitor the user's vital signs in the VR environment, combining aesthetics with high-tech practicality. Launching monitoring program...

records.name: VR Shoes
records.des: A footwear device necessary for VR battle simulations. It emits electrical signals to create the sensation that the wearer is performing various actions. Some crew member said, "These shoes are dragging me around."

records.name: Peach Heart Jacket
records.des: A jacket designed with hearts and peach-pink as its main elements, somewhat like the everyday outfit of the protagonists in old-time animations.

records.name: Stylish Demihuman Ears
records.des: A plain demihuman ear hairband with stylish earrings, stylish and free of pain. The only drawback is that the hairband part is too obvious.

records.name: Peach Heart Shoes
records.des: Peach-pink socks with lightweight canvas shoes embellished with heart patterns. Pinky, spring vibe.

records.name: "Angel's Proof"
records.des: A hoop that mysteriously remains hovering. Source Citadel members view it as an Angel's halo, while others harbor suspicions about it.

records.name: Railway Hunter Hat
records.des: An outfit that integrates classic bounty hunter elements from artworks alongside the traditional color scheme of the B.C.R.L. The hat's brim no longer obstructs the sun, allowing the hunter to focus solely on their prey.

records.name: KEEP Clerk Cap
records.des: The uniform cap for clerks in the KEEP Fried Chicken, with an elastic fabric strap added to the back of the hat to keep it from slipping down.

records.name: Blue Highlights
records.des: This lock of blue highlights (of your wig) shows off your unique status.

records.name: A.L. Design Sunglasses
records.des: A creation by Aleister, a renowned fashion designer, an artist and mayor of Cape City, showcasing both sunglasses and a wrap-around bandana. One ensemble, two fashion movements.

records.name: Platinum Fashion Demihuman Ears
records.des: Mechanical demihuman ears crafted in a vibrant red, a color currently in vogue in Platinum City. Look much better when worn with the entire outfit set.

records.name: Firefly Headwear
records.des: Headwear from the Firefly Set that gently sways atop your head when the wind blows.

records.name: Pineapple Sunglasses
records.des: The trendiest pineapple-themed sunglasses for this summer. These shades even allow you to use your nose as a harp when worn.

records.name: Unbewusstes Jacket
records.des: Exclusive to select members of Source Citadel, this set defies conventional principles by adapting seamlessly to diverse environments. It automatically adjusts its size to maintain optimal body temperature, ensuring comfort regardless of how it is worn.

records.name: Railway Hunter Jacket
records.des: An outfit that integrates classic bounty hunter elements from artworks alongside the traditional color scheme of the B.C.R.L. Unfortunately, modern bounty hunters no longer have to endure the rugged wilderness life of the past.

records.name: KEEP Clerk Set
records.des: A uniform tailored for KEEP Fried Chicken clerks. Its asymmetrical strap design aims at enhancing visual appeal, which has faced criticism from the busy staff members.

records.name: Special Agent Set
records.des: A stylish trench coat reminiscent of those worn by special agents in movies. This coat exudes an air of competence and integrity, making the wearer appear authoritative. Please present your ID!

records.name: A.L. Design Set
records.des: A creation by Aleister, a renowned fashion designer, an artist and mayor of Cape City. This ensemble blends elements from several seasons into a single suit, achieving a innovative harmony.

records.name: Modern Ninja Set
records.des: A jumpsuit from the Modern Ninja Set, meticulously crafted by Night Chains Lesage. Despite its appearance of limited mobility, the outfit features large-sized pockets to accommodate a plethora of essentials for urban exploration.

records.name: Platinum Fashion Set
records.des: A set crafted in a vibrant red, a color currently in vogue in Platinum City. Wear this attire and stand out as a trend-setter in the bustling malls of Platinum City!

records.name: Firefly Wings
records.des: The centerpiece of the Firefly Set, these Firefly Wings are delicately crafted from lightweight yarn. Positioned on the back, these translucent wings give the illusion of flight as you move.

records.name: Pineapple Jacket
records.des: The trendiest pineapple-themed set for this summer. Who lives in a large pineapple by the seaside?

records.name: Unbewusstes Boots
records.des: Shoes allocated to certain Source Citadel members. Opinions on these shoes vary among members, with some not really liking them and others really not liking them.

records.name: Railway Hunter Boots
records.des: An outfit that integrates classic bounty hunter elements from artworks alongside the traditional color scheme of the B.C.R.L. These boots are designed to be soft, cozy, and enduring, capable of withstanding extensive journeys along railroads.

records.name: KEEP Clerk Shoes
records.des: Shoes tailored for KEEP Fried Chicken clerks. The distinctive red and white striped boots are crafted from a special grease-resistant material, ensuring they remain clean and presentable even during busy shifts.

records.name: Special Agent Shoes
records.des: Stylish leather shoes reminiscent of those worn by special agents in movies. Step into these shoes and find the valor to navigate perilous streets. This is the life of an agent!

records.name: A.L Design Shoes
records.des: A creation by Aleister, a renowned fashion designer, an artist and mayor of Cape City. These unique leather shoes are timeless in style, transcending seasonal trends.

records.name: Modern Ninja Straw Shoes
records.des: Straw shoes from the Modern Ninja Set, meticulously crafted by Night Chains Lesage. Why should clothing be limited by their name? And who says straw shoes have to be made of straw? But ninjas must wear straw shoes!

records.name: Platinum Fashion Shoes
records.des: A set of shoes and socks crafted in a vibrant red, a color currently in vogue in Platinum City. Kitty elements are timeless, and the allure of the red hue is truly captivating.

records.name: Firefly Sandals
records.des: These sandals from the Firefly Set are incredibly lightweight. As you walk along the beach wearing them, it almost feels like you are walking on water. Rumor has it that some wearers have actually walked on water.

records.name: Pineapple Water Shoes
records.des: The trendiest pineapple-themed water shoes for this summer. "Are you ready, kids?!"

records.name: KEEP Clerk Intercom
records.des: A walkie-talkie for KEEP Fried Chicken clerks. "Emergency! An entire plate of burgers has fallen into the fryer for the fried chicken!"

records.name: Modern Ninja Mask
records.des: A mask from the Modern Ninja Set, meticulously crafted by Night Chains Lesage. It's said that this mask features an exceptionally efficient air filter that neutralizes all scents... even the smell of blood.

records.name: Platinum Fashion Facepiece
records.des: A band-aid shaped facepiece crafted in a vibrant red, a color currently in vogue in Platinum City. However, its rigid material might exert pressure on the wearer's nasal bridge...

records.name: Island Vacation Sunglasses
records.des: Classical sunglasses issued by COLUMBA for all conductors, emitting a delightful deep blue radiance. Time to enjoy the summer vacation!

records.idCN: 套装/dress47__夏季款列车长制服（自制）
records.name: Summer Conductor Uniform (Customized)
records.des: A summer uniform customized by the Conductor. While it offers less protection against morphic field pollution, its breathability has significantly improved... But hey, don't think about the end of your vacation just yet! Enjoy the moment while it lasts!

records.name: Island Vacation Flip-Flops
records.des: Classic flip-flops issued by COLUMBA for all conductors. With a simple shake, wearers can effortlessly rid the soles of sand, making them a perfect choice for leisurely walks around the well-designed island.

records.name: Yunxiu Bridge Standard Prison Uniform
records.des: Prison uniform tops distributed at Base Yunxiu Bridge. Its classical remorse blue design, careful sewing, and iron bars elements worth collecting even if you're not a prisoner!

records.name: Yunxiu Bridge Standard Prison Pants
records.des: Prison uniform bottoms distributed at Base Yunxiu Bridge. For some reason, these ordinary canvas pants have been labeled as "the best Yunxiu Bridge contracting souvenir" on various forums.

records.name: Gourmet Pirate Cap
records.des: The pirate hat worn by the third legendary pirate, "Gourmet," from a popular children's TV program. This pirate's sole ambition is to discover the most delicious cuisine.

records.name: Skulleye's Adventure
records.des: The pirate hat worn by the second legendary pirate, "Skulleye," from a popular children's TV program. Years after Pink Beard disappeared, Skulleye sailed the same waters as him and discovered the secret of the treasure.

records.name: placeholder
records.des: 黑灰色的羽毛状头饰，按照某位异界来客断断续续的小声描述复原而成。据说可以展开成更大的翅膀。

records.name: Philosopher's Laurel
records.des: A laurel used in the Empire to honor great thinkers. In the legend, the great hunter whispers to his friend, "You shall be my tree. With your leaves my victors shall wreathe their brows. You shall have your part in all my triumphs."

records.name: Pink Beard's Ambition
records.des: The pirate hat worn by the legendary pirate, "Pink Beard," from a popular children's TV program. The decoration on the hat carries his resolve in sailing across all the oceans... On the other side of the sea is treasure!

records.name: Revelation Eyepatch
records.des: A designer from a fashion brand created this accessory based on the public rumors about the "Angels" of the Source Citadel—an eyepatch symbolizing absolute erudition.

records.name: Zebra Glasses
records.des: One of the items in the "Indirect·Zebra" series set, contains the calmness and leisure of a zebra.

records.name: Decorative Braided Shoes
records.des: The boots conveying the spirit of a road movie. Tie on the souvenirs gained along the journey and set off on the road again.

records.name: Revelation Crown
records.des: A designer from a fashion brand created this accessory based on the public rumors about the "Angels" of the Source Citadel—a crown of feathers symbolizing supreme sanctity.

records.name: Zebra Cap
records.des: One of the items in the "Indirect·Zebra" series set, embodies the handsome agility of a zebra.

records.name: Revelation Ear Feather
records.des: A designer from a fashion brand created this accessory based on the public rumors about the "Angels" of the Source Citadel—ear feathers symbolizing knowing everything.

records.name: "Screw"
records.des: The ornament conveying the spirit of a road movie. Where did this screw come from, and where is it going to be screwed in?

records.name: Zebra-striped Shoes
records.des: One of the items in the "Indirect·Zebra" series set. Although zebras don't have boots with such patterns, this design is still very popular.

records.name: placeholder
records.des: 在维蒂林场的调查过程中获得的“特色物品”之一。假如蒙上双眼便可对一切视而不见……

records.name: Philosopher's Earrings
records.des: Metal earrings featuring the laurel element. While it may be a bit painful to clip on, bear with it for the sake of classical beauty.

records.name: Hamburger Hat
records.des: An ornament conveying the spirit of a road movie. A hamburger hat is only genuine when it has a hamburger in it.

records.name: Gourmet Pirate Beard
records.des: The pirate beard of the third legendary pirate, "Gourmet," from a popular children's TV program. Returning to simplicity is the true classic!

records.name: placeholder
records.des: 黑灰色的羽毛状耳饰，是头饰的制作过程中诞生的副产物。其中蕴含了某位异界来客施展的小小奇迹。

records.name: Philosopher's Monocle
records.des: A overly thick monocle featuring the technique of more than a century ago, restoring the vintage style and the terrible weight. When worn, it weights down the bridge of the wearer's nose and causes pain.

records.name: Skulleye's Folly
records.des: The eyepatch worn by the second legendary pirate, "Skulleye," from a popular children's TV program. Skulleye got his nickname from his folly when he mistook someone else as an impostor of himself due to a hallucination caused by sirens.

records.name: Zebra Star
records.des: One of the items in the "Indirect·Zebra" series set. What? Star is zebra too?

records.name: Exemplary Conductor's Hat
records.des: The conductor's hat customized by COLUMBA for exemplary conductors with COLUMBA's logo. Wearing this hat makes you emanate a sense of dignity and seriousness.

records.name: Exemplary Conductor's Gown
records.des: The conductor's gown customized by COLUMBA for exemplary conductors. While it does not provide pollution resistance as most gowns do, this has a stylish design. In the book "Railroad History" published by TMT, conductors of the old world have worn similar uniforms to drive trains.

records.name: Exemplary Conductor's Boots
records.des: The conductor's boots customized by COLUMBA for exemplary conductors. Classic black style. The sole of the boots is signed by each conductor themselves, an honor and responsibility reserved exclusively for the wearer.

records.name: Philosopher's Concern
records.des: Facial physiognomy in bonfire cities has different interpretations of the location of moles, but generally speaking, a mole located on the lower left side of the face indicates a deep mind befitting a wise philosopher.

records.name: Pink Beard's Glory
records.des: The symbol of the legendary pirate, "Pink Beard," from a popular children's TV program. People with pink beard always seem to have wonderful powers.

records.name: Gourmet Pirate Anchor
records.des: The iconic ornament worn by the third legendary pirate, "Gourmet," from a popular children's TV program. Drop anchor and head to the restaurant at this dock—!

records.name: Skulleye's Voyage
records.des: The earrings worn by the second legendary pirate, "Skulleye," from a popular children's TV program. For seafarers, there is no end to their quest to conquer the seas!

records.name: Pink Beard's Legacy
records.des: The legacy left by the legendary pirate, "Pink Beard," from the final season of a popular children's TV program. While the stories made children burst into tears, the sales of this type of earrings as merchandise skyrocketed.

records.name: Classical Detective Hunting Hat
records.des: Originally a hunting hat, it later became popular among truth-seekers. After all, the pursuit of truth can be as thrilling as a hunt, right?

records.idCN: 套装/dress51__古典鉴识斗篷风衣
records.name: Classical Detective Trench Coat
records.des: This classic trench coat style exudes wisdom and composure while providing warmth. Paired with a bow tie and white gloves, it conveys a sense of determination and equips the wearer with the ability to unravel any mystery.

records.name: Classical Detective Leather Shoes
records.des: Handcrafted leather shoes, designed to fit perfectly, aiding in the wearer's quest for truth. The understated pointed-toe design is both elegant and timeless.

records.name: Little Detective Sneakers
records.des: The classic sneakers worn by the protagonist of "The Little Detective." While they may seem an unconventional choice, they often become iconic classics in animations.

records.name: Little Detective Suit
records.des: The classic suit worn by the protagonist of "The Little Detective." Even a little detective has his unique sense of fashion.

records.name: Truth Seeker's Glasses
records.des: The classic glasses worn by the protagonist of "The Little Detective." When viewed through these glasses, no criminal can escape justice.

records.name: Bodyguard Pigtails
records.des: The pigtails sported by a girl serving as a "bodyguard" on a specific train. These pigtails don't slow her down one bit!

records.name: Bodyguard Battle Suit
records.des: The battle suit worn by a girl serving as a "bodyguard" on a specific train. Evils be cleansed!

records.name: Bodyguard Short Boots
records.des: The boots worn by a girl serving as a "bodyguard" on a specific train, smooth and sleek. Ready to kick into action!

records.idCN: 眼饰/dress53__破碎的蒸汽锻冶目镜
records.name: Broken Steam Forging Goggles
records.des: This monocle garners popularity among young engineers in the station.

records.name: Steam Forging Set
records.des: The attire commonly worn by young engineers in the station, including a small bag that does not hinder mobility while carrying useful tools.

records.name: Steam Forging Shoes
records.des: The shoes commonly worn by young engineers in the station, suitable for scaling different heights.

records.name: Gale Blader's Suit
records.des: The suit worn by the protagonist in Gale Blader, Night Chains' latest ninja-themed action movie. A true ninja always blends into the nights!

records.name: Gale Blader's Mask
records.des: The mask worn by the protagonist in Gale Blader, Night Chains' latest ninja-themed action movie. A true ninja always keeps their face hidden!

records.name: Gale Blader's Slippers
records.des: The shoes worn by the protagonist in Gale Blader, Night Chains' latest ninja-themed action movie. A true ninja always... wears cooling slippers!

records.name: Bunny Sailor Hat
records.des: It is said that this hat was worn by Lady Bunny of the Ocean Voyager and can signify her unique identity.

records.name: Bunny Sailor Dress
records.des: The skirt worn by Lady Bunny of the Ocean Voyager. This lovely white skirt, embellished with sea-themed decorations, mirrors the beauty of the ocean.

records.name: Bunny Sailor Shoes
records.des: The shoes worn by Lady Bunny of the Ocean Voyager. They can be easily dried even if they get wet from the waves!

records.name: Crimson Plaid Headband
records.des: The headband worn by the crew of the Ocean Voyager. Those boarding must maintain a neat appearance!

records.name: Crimson Plaid Dress
records.des: The dress worn by the crew of the Ocean Voyager. The red plaid is classic and cute, and the apron paired with it adds a practical touch.

records.name: Crimson Plaid Shoes
records.des: The leather shoes worn by the crew of the Ocean Voyager. They have soft and wear-resistant soles that can adapt to various climbing and descending demands!

records.name: Kaguya · VS Helmet
records.des: The wearable helmet launched jointly by the trendy toy brand under Night Chains and the popular fighting game in Bonfire City, Kaguya model. Once you put it on, you can pilot a robot to perform dreamlike sword skills - as described in the game.

records.name: Vassago · VS Helmet
records.des: The wearable helmet launched jointly by the trendy toy brand under Night Chains and the popular fighting game in Bonfire City, Vassago model. Once you put it on, you can experience unparalleled mecha construct - as described in the game.

records.name: Poison Rose Sun Hat
records.des: The headpiece from the witch-themed set "Poison Rose" launched by Night Chains Land. Deep red rose, red as a dream.

records.name: Poison Rose Dress
records.des: The dress from the witch-themed set "Poison Rose" launched by Night Chains Land. Entwined vines and overlapping leaves are one of the design inspirations for this outfit.

records.name: Poison Rose Leather Shoes
records.des: The leather shoes from the witch-themed set "Poison Rose" launched by Night Chains Land. The dark gray leather resembles the shadows of a rose bush.

records.name: Evil Bear Headband
records.des: A headband with an evil bear design, designer unknown, perhaps made by a small manufacturer attempting to replicate the success of Night Chains Land.

records.name: Evil Bear Earrings
records.des: Earrings with an evil bear design. That said, people can't really make out the shape... Is this really a bear?

records.name: Evil Bear Glasses
records.des: Glasses with an evil bear design, designed in this shape for some reason, resulting in taking twice as long to process compared to other glasses.

records.name: Melting Honey Jar
records.des: Fashion hat inspired by a honey jar, unexpectedly soft in material, yet still very heavy.

records.name: Melting Honey Earclip
records.des: Fashion earclips inspired by honey extracted from a honey jar, make the wearer very sweet... probably.

records.name: Lottery Hat
records.des: The same top hat as the staff at the Night Chains Land lottery counter. This way, you'll be able to spot it in the crowd, right?

records.name: Lottery Earrings
records.des: The same earrings as the staff at the Night Chains Land lottery counter. Good luck, meow!

records.name: Tea Party Attendant Headwear
records.des: Fresh and cute. "The bow needs to be tidied up, as this is the duty of a maid."

records.name: Tea Party Attendant Dress
records.des: Fresh and cute, with ribbons on the clothes serving not only as decoration but also as a marker of identity.

records.name: Tea Party Attendant Shoes
records.des: Fresh and cute. "Be careful when serving tea, Lord of Black Iron!"

records.name: Mournful Veil
records.des: This "witch's hat" was reconstructed based on the descriptions from the children recovered from the witch abduction incident, with some differences from the original.

records.name: Mournful Nightwing
records.des: This "witch's earring" was reconstructed based on the descriptions from the children recovered from the witch abduction incident, with some differences from the original.

records.name: Lunette Plush Hat
records.des: The official mascot hat produced by Night Chains Land, Lunette version. Wearing this hat makes you the most beautiful and adorable person in the park!

records.name: Umbra Satin Cap
records.des: The official mascot hat produced by Night Chains Land, Umbra version. Wearing this hat makes you tonight's big star, Umbra!

records.name: Proverb Hat
records.des: A magical hat with several big mouths. It is said that the person who wears it can receive the "most suitable proverb."

records.name: Proverb Glasses
records.des: Eyeglasses with a peculiar shape, said to allow the wearer to see the truth.

records.name: Proverb Shoes
records.des: Shoes adorned with bows, it is said they can lead you to sought-after truth!

records.name: Night Flight Cap
records.des: It is said that there is a flower called "Night Flight," and anyone who finds it can gain the ability to learn to fly overnight... The bow on this cap is dyed with the juice of that flower.

records.name: Good Broom Earrings
records.des: "Good broom... what does it mean? Is there another bad broom in the world, Miss Helena?"

records.name: Forest after Rain
records.des: The way to wear this ornament is to evenly sprinkle the components on your head and water them. After waiting for about 1 to 3 days, you can gain a complete wearing experience. Note that you should not wash your hair during this period.

records.name: Scarface Mushroom
records.des: Earrings in the shape of a scarface mushroom. Shiitake mushroom? No, how could a shiitake mushroom look like this!

records.name: Inspiration Mushroom
records.des: An exaggerated hat in the shape of Inspiration Mushroom. It is said that as long as you wear this hat and start humming the "Inspiration Mushroom's Tune," your mood will suddenly improve.

records.name: Wise Owl
records.des: A plush owl doll made of felt material, said to enhance one's thinking ability. And it's so fluffy...

records.name: Wise Eyelashes
records.des: Glasses with very thick lenses, paired with bright and spirited eyelashes, clearly something only a true scholar can wear.

records.name: Maneki-neko Mask
records.des: A mask inspired by the legends of Ranshin City, said to attract fortune. Can such a thing really be more effective than a Chaos Money Tree...

records.name: Maneki-neko Paws
records.des: Shoes that mimic cat paws, replicate the adorable paw pads, making a sound with each step. However, the noise when walking can be a bit annoying...

records.name: Café Au Lait Tiered Dress
records.des: A tiered dress from Night Chains Lesage's "Café Au Lait" set. Quite heavy, but customers who appreciate this style will naturally understand its value.

records.name: Café Au Lait Headband
records.des: A headband from Night Chains Lesage's "Café Au Lait" set. It is adorned with a small bear floating on cream, making every sip sweet and fragrant.

records.name: Café Au Lait Shoes
records.des: Leather shoes from Night Chains Lesage's "Café Au Lait" set, with soles that are light and soft, as if walking on clouds.

records.name: Rosy River Crown
records.des: The crown dedicated to the king of blood and night, legend has it that he waits by the bank of the rosy river. Note: Made of titanium steel, containing no silver components.

records.name: Rosy River Earrings
records.des: The earrings dedicated to the king of blood and night, wearing them seems to allow one to hear a rustling flow. Who has such sharp ears?

records.name: Rosy River Gown
records.des: The gown dedicated to the king of blood and night, adorned with the roses that person loved most, simply because this flower is red as blood.

records.name: Rosy River Boots
records.des: The boots dedicated to the king of blood and night, with soft soles suitable for walking under the moonlit night. Silently arriving...

records.name: Unbewusstes Jacket
records.des: Exclusive to select members of Source Citadel, this set defies conventional principles by adapting seamlessly to diverse environments. It automatically adjusts its size to maintain optimal body temperature, ensuring comfort regardless of how it is worn.

records.name: Clock Tower Hunter Hat
records.des: The hat worn by the Clock Tower Hunter when he appears at the night of full moon. Although the edge is already damaged, his original will has not wavered in the slightest.

records.name: Clock Tower Hunter Coat
records.des: The coat worn by the Clock Tower Hunter when he appears at the night of full moon. Only rest is the end of the long road. As long as the hunter can still breathe...

records.name: Clock Tower Hunter Boots
records.des: The boots worn by the Clock Tower Hunter when he appears at the night of full moon. How much of the path treaded is rain and mud, and how much is filth and blood?

records.name: Pointy-Ear Windproof Goggles
records.des: Goggles with black cat ear-shaped decorations. The designer explained that the cat ear part is meant to add an extra playful touch to the worker's outfit.

records.name: Windproof Jumpsuit
records.des: Windproof suit made from special materials. It has a great texture and, at the same time, is somewhat heavier than regular workwear.

records.name: Windproof Boots
records.des: Windproof work boots made of special material, warm-keeping, waterproof, and anti-erosion, but very difficult to put on and take off.

records.name: Tick-tock Station Hat
records.des: The tall ceremonial hat of Tick-tock Station attendant. Tick-tock, where are you going?

records.name: Tick-tock Station Coat
records.des: The attire of Tick-tock Station attendant for the fourth season. The attire for the third season is a trench coat, the second is a shirt, and the first attire ran away with the train to another part of the world...

records.name: Tick-tock Station Shoes
records.des: The standard leather shoes of Tick-tock Station attendant. Wearing these shoes allows you to walk much faster than the hands of a clock.

records.name: Bunny Demihuman Ear
records.des: Extremely realistic bunny ears, with a very smooth texture. It is said that some bunny demihuman have complained that this accessory infringes on the various legal rights of demihuman.

records.name: Red Amulet Pendant
records.des: A red amulet obtained in the temple of Ranshin City. Brings good luck. However, this one is just a replica.

records.name: Ranshin Student Skirt
records.des: Student skirts commonly used in Ranshin City schools. This piece has been modified to be more activity-friendly.

records.name: Ranshin Student Shoes
records.des: Student shoes commonly used in Ranshin City schools. This pair has been modified to be more suitable for long-distance walking.

records.name: Stellar Dreamscape
records.des: A witch hat recreated based on the description by the crew members who experienced the witch abduction incident, endowed with a slight amount of magic by two real witches. A dream as if thousands of stellar lights were falling.

records.name: Crimson Lightning
records.des: Highlights suitable for solo travelers. It is said that at some time and place, there was a person who appeared and disappeared like a crimson lightning.

records.name: Tea Room Idler's Gown
records.des: Past common clothing seen in the areas around Ranshin City. Wearing this and sitting in a tea house, one would never be mistaken for someone with something to do.

records.name: Tea Room Idler's Straw Sandals
records.des: Past common straw sandals seen in the areas around Ranshin City. Although they differ from traditional straw sandals, this pair is truly trendy.

records.name: Scripture Pavilion Headband
records.des: The headband commonly used by the curator of the Scripture Pavilion; simple, classic, and elegant.

records.name: Scripture Pavilion Dress
records.des: The ceremonial dress commonly worn by the curator of the Scripture Pavilion featuring a luxurious and unique hollow-out design - however, others who put on the same style will find the dress much heavier than expected.

records.name: Scripture Pavilion High Heels
records.des: The high heels commonly worn by the curator of the Scripture Pavilion. Truly powerful people can walk briskly no matter how daunting the heels they wear.

records.name: Pope's Crown
records.des: The crown of the seventh Pope, designed for a specific girl, but it actually looks quite cute on someone else's head too. A certain outlander expressed strong disdain for this.

records.name: Pope's Gown
records.des: The gown of the seventh pope, every thread or fiber has received the blessing of the Mechanical God. By wearing this splendid attire, one receives the grace of the Mechanical God, but that alone is not enough to become a "Pope".

records.name: Pope's Socks
records.des: The socks (and leather shoes) of the seventh pope, probably be the only part of her attire that relatively suits her age. Bright vertical stripes, like shadows cast by invisible railings.

records.name: Nero Helmet
records.des: The latest "Outlander" series helmet from the toy brand under Night Chains, Nero's model. The tag says "Once worn, it can devour its wearer"… Wait... wait wait wait...

records.name: Tech Eye Sun Hat
records.des: The sun hat worn by the head of Tech Eye, more decorative than practical. After all, she doesn't even wake up during the day.

records.name: Tech Eye Monocle
records.des: The monocle worn by the head of Tech Eye, not used for vision correction but for peering into the essence of mechanical structures.

records.name: Tech Eye Dress
records.des: The heavy ceremonial dress worn by the head of Tech Eye, suits the petite figure of its original owner. Wonder how it would fit on someone else...

records.name: Tech Eye Stockings
records.des: The stockings and leather shoes worn by the head of Tech Eye. Somehow, looking at these strangely styled stockings, you are reminded of a certain outlander.

records.name: Stellar Dreamscape
records.des: A witch hat recreated based on the description by the crew members who experienced the witch abduction incident, endowed with a slight amount of magic by two real witches. A dream as if thousands of stellar lights were falling.

records.name: Traveling Knight Helmet
records.des: Part of the protagonist's costume in the blockbuster "Fallen Ring" by Loop United Cinemas. Traveler who conceals appearance, where are you going?

records.name: Traveling Knight Plate Armor
records.des: Part of the protagonist's costume in the blockbuster "Fallen Ring" by Loop United Cinemas. The distant land tells a story, the Fallen Ring has already shattered...

records.name: Traveling Knight Metal Boots
records.des: Part of the protagonist's costume in the blockbuster "Fallen Ring" by Loop United Cinemas. Tread the desolate paths and become the new lord.

records.idCN: 套装/dress82__惠比寿高中制服裙
records.name: 惠比寿高中制服裙
records.des: 黑月旗下游戏公司“闹天堂”推出的新游戏《沉默山F》中女主角的穿着打扮。在游戏故事中，这是这座山间小镇里唯一高中的校服……咦，她的钢管去哪了？

records.idCN: 鞋子/dress82__惠比寿高中制服鞋
records.name: 惠比寿高中制服鞋
records.des: 黑月旗下游戏公司“闹天堂”推出的新游戏《沉默山F》中女主角的穿着打扮。在游戏故事中，女主角为涉过小溪而丢掉了一只鞋子和一边……想想就好痛！

records.name: 魔法南瓜头
records.des: 被两位魔女过度装饰的南瓜头套，年长的那位认为装饰多些才更有节日气氛，年幼的那位则不小心购买了太多装饰材料。在魔法的加持下，它总算维持了一个适合戴在头上的重量……

records.name: 银月花冠
records.des: 以洒下清辉的银色月亮为主题的礼服花冠。

records.name: 夜雾礼裙
records.des: 参考几位异界来客的意见设计的礼裙，以“调查团的礼服”为概念，将核心定为了“雾”。材质轻薄贴身，便于活动。

records.name: 秋叶礼鞋
records.des: 以秋日的金色落叶为主题的礼服鞋。

records.name: 落霜礼鞋
records.des: 以秋日的洁白落霜为主题的礼服鞋。

records.name: 夜雾礼服
records.des: 参考几位异界来客的意见设计的礼服，以“调查团的礼服”为概念，将核心定为了“雾”。剪裁大方得体，不失优雅。

records.name: 辉阳花冠
records.des: 以照耀万物的灿烂阳光为主题的礼服花冠。

records.name: 星空魔女帽
records.des: 两位魔女为表谢意而制作的魔女帽，缝制和设计均由她们二人共同完成。循此苦旅，以达群星。

records.name: 热舞星月夜目镜
records.des: “热舞星月夜”套装中搭配的目镜。透过那双眼镜能看见怎样的星空？

records.name: 热舞星月夜耳机
records.des: “热舞星月夜”套装中搭配的耳机，采取了无线连接的方式，并且能够牢固地挂在耳朵上，无论怎么活动都不会轻易掉落。

records.name: 热舞星月夜套装
records.des: “热舞星月夜”套装中的主体部分，以一幅著名的油画作为设计灵感。化身闪耀星夜！

records.name: 热舞星月夜套靴
records.des: “热舞星月夜”套装中搭配的套靴，可以拆分成多个不同部件。

records.name: 吉他英雄发夹
records.des: 简单的两色小球塑料发绳，背后却承载了一段吉他英雄不懈练习技巧的故事。

records.name: 吉他英雄套装
records.des: 朴素的学生运动服搭配朴素的学生校服。吉他英雄隐于学生之间的时候，穿的就是这样的衣服！

records.name: 吉他英雄室外鞋
records.des: 普通的平价室外鞋，吉他英雄只在偶尔离开家里去采购的时候才会穿。

records.name: 晨星礼帽
records.des: 以破晓前天空中的晨星作为设计理念的礼帽。在那光芒之下的原野上，有眺望着它的小小花朵。

records.name: 晨星耳饰
records.des: 以破晓前天空中的晨星作为设计理念的耳饰。花朵悄悄绽放的时候，星星有没有望见呢？

records.name: 晨星礼裙
records.des: 以破晓前天空中的晨星作为设计理念的礼裙，按曼杜斯帝国流行的少女礼裙样式制作。颇受部分乘员的好评。

records.name: 晨星皮靴
records.des: 以破晓前天空中的晨星作为设计理念的皮靴。微凉的皮革触感如同晨间洒落大地的露珠。

records.name: 蜡烛帽
records.des: 形似燃尽蜡烛的帽子，让人不由得担心烛泪会不会随帽檐流下。因为用了真的蜡烛塑形，所以每顶都独一无二。

records.name: 苦刑耳钉
records.des: 灵感来自骑士小说中刑罚的耳钉。看起来很尖，实际上并不会划到脸。

records.name: 森月水手服
records.des: 森月高中的水手服款式制服，少见的设计，只有该学校的优秀学生才能穿着。

records.name: 森月制服鞋
records.des: 森月高中的制服鞋，虽然穿感较为舒适，但仍然不适合进行任何形式的运动或长途跋涉。

records.name: 弦音制服鞋
records.des: The standard leather shoes of Tick-tock Station attendant. Wearing these shoes allows you to walk much faster than the hands of a clock.

records.name: 弦音夏装
records.des: 令人想起愉快青春时光的制服，用对制服来说过于精良的面料缝制。拨动心弦的，究竟是谁的手呢？

records.idCN: 头饰/dress88__科伦巴列车长典礼帽
records.name: 科伦巴列车长典礼帽
records.des: 科伦巴商会为模范列车长设计的正装的配套帽子，方方正正，不知为何却能在头上戴得很稳。

records.idCN: 套装/dress88__科伦巴列车长典礼制服
records.name: 科伦巴列车长典礼制服
records.des: 科伦巴商会为模范列车长设计的正装制服，有几处别出心裁的小设计，低调而不简单。

records.idCN: 鞋子/dress88__科伦巴列车长典礼皮鞋
records.name: 科伦巴列车长典礼皮鞋
records.des: 科伦巴商会为模范列车长设计的正装的配套皮鞋，走在车厢过道中会与地面碰撞出悦耳的脚步声。

records.name: 湖光魔女帽
records.des: 某位魔女在受到黑月游乐城中发生的事件启发而制作的魔女帽。如同月光下的湖面，倒映粼粼湖光。

records.name: 纽带制服
records.des: 某部少女乐队相关的作品中出现的虚构高中制服，象征着主人公们偶然相遇、结成乐队的过程。

records.name: 纽带制服鞋
records.des: 某部少女乐队相关的作品中出现的虚构高中制服所配的鞋子，象征着主人公们为乐队奔走的青春时光。

records.name: 萃境礼服
records.des: 萃境联盟为列车长定制的礼服，披风的装饰颜色取自极光的颜色。外套的内衬里用特殊的丝线绣有格言：跨越界限，重塑花园。

records.name: 萃境礼帽
records.des: 萃境联盟为列车长定制的礼帽，象征智慧与远见的猫头鹰标志微微闪烁。

records.name: 萃境皮靴
records.des: 萃境联盟为列车长定制的皮靴，兼具帝国和地表的服装特点，似乎也寄托了设计者美好的愿望。

records.name: 花崎川制服鞋
records.des: 花崎川学园的制服鞋，据说曾有一位本校优秀毕业生穿着这双鞋从三楼跳下而毫发无伤。

records.name: 花崎川水手服
records.des: 花崎川学园的制服，该学校以气氛轻松、多方向培养在学生之间人气很高。

records.name: 罗刹角
records.des: 岚心城民间故事中出现甚多的角色头上长着的角，至于为什么折断了一边还是别深究了。

records.name: 罗刹耳饰
records.des: 以岚心城民间故事中出现甚多的角色为灵感制作的流行耳饰，设计来自于驱灾辟邪的图案。

records.name: 罗刹面
records.des: 岚心城民间故事中出现甚多的角色所戴的面具，据说通过这只面具发白的眼睛，能够看见另一个世界的景象。

records.name: 未咲高中制服
records.des: 未咲高中的标准制服，没有什么特点，但却代表着平和幸福的日常和小卖部的甜甜蜜瓜包香气。

records.name: 未咲高中制服鞋
records.des: 未咲高中的标准制服鞋，柔软舒适，便于战斗。为什么要说便于战斗？

records.name: 甜梦睡裙
records.des: 为休闲和休息量身打造的宽松睡裙，设计师特殊调整过裙子的花边使其不至于造成活动中的不适。

records.name: 甜梦眼罩
records.des: 绘有可爱图案的眼罩，象征着不会被打扰的甜蜜睡眠。

records.name: 甜梦居家鞋
records.des: 鞋底过于柔软的鞋子，不适合穿出卧室以外的任何地方。

records.name: 街头风格酷马甲
records.des: “街头风格”套装中的部件，能够秀出穿戴者优越的手臂线条。

records.name: 街头风格厚底鞋
records.des: “街头风格”套装中的部件，据说鞋底非常地不防滑，但可以增高。

records.name: 街头风格宽檐帽
records.des: “街头风格”套装中的部件，比起遮阳，这顶帽子似乎更注重装饰性。

records.name: 疏影斜
records.des: 武林源风格的便装。疏影横斜水清浅，暗香浮动月黄昏。

records.name: 荷叶裁
records.des: 武林源风格的裙装。荷叶罗裙一色裁，芙蓉向脸两边开。

records.name: 吉日华服
records.des: 为迎来成婚的大喜之日而为虎跃堂少主量身定做的华服。

records.name: 惊微尘
records.des: 武林源风格的便鞋。东风陌上惊微尘，游人初乐岁华新。

records.name: 入池中
records.des: 武林源风格的布鞋。乱入池中看不见，闻歌始觉有人来。

records.name: 喜鞋
records.des: 为迎来成婚的大喜之日而为虎跃堂少主量身定做的布鞋。穿着好像不怎么便于跑步。

records.name: 喜珰
records.des: 选西湖最优的淡水珍珠配合流苏制作的耳饰，在武林被称为“珰”。

records.name: 红线牵
records.des: 为迎来成婚的大喜之日而为虎跃堂少主所设计的发型，按照武林传统，应于婚礼当夜由结婚对象亲手解开。

records.name: 红线牵
records.des: 为迎来成婚的大喜之日而为虎跃堂少主所设计的发型，按照武林传统，应于婚礼当夜由结婚对象亲手解开。

records.name: 弄臣套装
records.des: 演艺人员的戏服，扮演剧中的一名帝国弄臣。服装在他人看来奇怪又如何？弄臣有自己的方法，把一切都颠倒过来。

records.name: 弄臣帽
records.des: 演艺人员的戏服，扮演剧中的一名帝国弄臣。即使抓住帽子上的小球，也无法将弄臣的地位扯下。

records.name: 弄臣耳钉
records.des: 演艺人员的戏服，扮演剧中的一名帝国弄臣。“谁允许了，你们这些笨蛋！给我穿出一个窟窿来！”

records.name: 弄臣鞋
records.des: 演艺人员的戏服，扮演剧中的一名帝国弄臣。一双过于柔软的鞋子，一串踏在宫殿地砖上也不会引人注意的脚步——

records.name: 异星救援套装
records.des: 出自一部可爱的外星人电影中的套装。似乎是借用了同船其余船员的衣物……等等，其余的船员去哪了？

records.name: 异星救援眼罩
records.des: 出自一部可爱的外星人电影中的眼罩。戴上以后就能分辨外星人的肢体动作含义了！

records.name: 异星救援通讯机
records.des: 出自一部可爱的外星人电影中的通讯器。可以翻译外星人发出的滴滴嘟嘟之声。

records.name: 异星救援靴
records.des: 出自一部可爱的外星人电影中的靴子。可以牢牢扣在宇航船的舱壁上，防止乱飘。

records.name: 星仪魔女帽
records.des: 与马吉拉·星仪同一款式的魔女帽。她亲自为这顶帽子稍加调整，使它更适合最亲爱的车长亲。

records.name: 牛来了连体衣
records.des: 大热儿童动画电影《牛来了》中主角的装扮。穿上以后让人有一种想要呼唤妈妈的温暖冲动……

records.name: 牛来了套装鞋
records.des: 大热儿童动画电影《牛来了》中主角的装扮，穿着舒服柔软，但需要当心别被小绳头绊倒。

records.name: 牛来了头套
records.des: 大热儿童动画电影《牛来了》中主角的装扮，戴上以后可以让人产生一种安心感。顶个脑门吧。

records.name: 烁梦尖顶帽
records.des: 与菲妮娅·烁梦同一款式的尖顶帽。追逐着远方闪烁之梦的证明。

records.name: 雪猎帽
records.des: 居住在寒冷地区的亚人的装扮。由于亚人的耳朵容易因寒冷而淤血……喂喂？戴上这帽子还听得见外面说话吗~？

records.name: 雪猎套装
records.des: 居住在寒冷地区的亚人的装扮。即使亚人本身已经毛茸茸的了，也还是会因极端天气而觉得冷呀。

records.name: 雪猎靴
records.des: 居住在寒冷地区的亚人的装扮。防滑又保暖，不过因为套装的受众是人类所以并没有设计多种适合亚人的脚型。

records.name: 爆虫帽
records.des: 亮晶晶的帽子，外形模仿了一种著名的桦树生物。希望这里面没有装着危险液体……

records.name: 爆虫腿耳饰
records.des: 灵感来自桦树生物节肢的耳饰。不看原型的话……这个或许还挺时尚的吧？

records.name: 调皮兔发箍
records.des: 兔子耳朵形状的发箍。难道是曾有过一只蓝兔子和另一只红兔子来过？

records.name: 虎头帽
records.des: 东大陆的传统服饰经过改良后的款式，据说设计的初衷是保佑孩子生龙活虎、精神百倍。

records.name: 绒绒球耳饰
records.des: 毛茸茸的毛线球做的耳饰。既温暖又百搭，就是会稍微有点儿挠得脖子痒痒。

records.name: 不开心帽
records.des: 心情不好的一顶帽子。原型不明。

records.name: 湿哒哒耳钉
records.des: 似乎哭过了的一枚耳钉。原因不明。

records.name: 男列车长发型
records.des: 帅气随性的日常发型，有点儿像是没睡醒。

records.name: 流星印记
records.des: 以“衬托流星的夜幕”为灵感设计的背心，舒适宽松，套头即穿。

records.name: 流星尾
records.des: 以“流星的痕迹”为灵感设计的运动鞋，虽说怎么看都只是洒了许多亮晶晶粉末的鞋子而已……

records.name: 流星穿刺
records.des: 以“划过天际的流星”为灵感设计的耳饰，佩戴时让人担心会被星星的光芒戳到脸。

records.name: 螺丝脑袋
records.des: 在悠久工业历史的铁山城经常用这个词来形容做事过于制作的人。但螺丝脑袋看久了倒也挺可爱的……

records.name: 嘻哈套装
records.des: 具有嘻哈气息的套装，部件繁多，每次穿上和脱下都需要很多个步骤。

records.name: 嘻哈鞋
records.des: 具有嘻哈气息的鞋子，虽不起眼，却也对整体装扮起到了贡献气氛的重要作用。

records.name: 嘻哈耳饰
records.des: 具有嘻哈气息的耳饰，每个耳圈都亮闪闪的。

records.name: 妙妙脆角
records.des: 仿造冰激凌甜筒、可丽饼卷和小饼干的形状制作的可爱头饰，在篝火城年轻人之间非常流行。“顶着两个妙妙脆角就来了！”

records.name: 另一主角盔甲
records.des: 按某个故事中的“主角”的装束制作的盔甲，由于采用了特殊的现代材料，比起原件应该要轻便上好几倍。

records.name: 另一主角腿甲
records.des: 按某个故事中的“主角”的装束制作的腿甲。似乎无论什么样的困难场面都能跨越。

records.name: 另一主角头盔
records.des: 按某个故事中的“主角”的装束制作的头盔，能够完全遮掩面容。

records.name: 既视感
records.des: 仿照某位少女的风格打理的发型，不带蝴蝶结。让人情不自禁地想讲一个故事。

records.name: 异构假面·单
records.des: 以桦树空间中的诡谲景色为灵感设计的面部装饰。谁来诠释一个故事的真伪？

records.name: 异构假面·双
records.des: 以桦树空间中的诡谲景色为灵感设计的面部装饰。谁来诠释一种幻象的含义？
